response.reading_text: The city's historic center is a maze of narrow streets and alleys. Visitors often get lost in the area, but this can be part of its charm. The buildings are a mix of old and new, with some dating back to the Middle Ages and others being modern constructions. The city council has implemented measures to make the area more accessible, including installing signs and maps to help tourists navigate. However, some locals complain that these efforts have made the area too touristy and lost its original character.

questions.question: What is a common experience for visitors in the city's historic center?
options: They often find it easy to get around
They usually stay in one place
They frequently get lost, but this can be part of its charm
They are always accompanied by guides
questions.answer: They frequently get lost, but this can be part of its charm

questions.question: What is a notable feature of the buildings in the historic center?
options: Mostly modern
A mix of old and new
All from the same era
None are particularly noteworthy
questions.answer: A mix of old and new

questions.question: What is the purpose of the signs and maps installed by the city council?
options: To make the area more exclusive
To promote local businesses
To help tourists navigate
To discourage visitors from coming

questions.question: How do some locals feel about the city council's efforts to improve accessibility?
options: They are very supportive and think it's a great idea
They are neutral and don't have an opinion
They think it has made the area too touristy and lost its original character
They don't care either way
questions.answer: They think it has made the area too touristy and lost its original character

questions.question: What can be inferred about the author's attitude towards the city council's efforts?
options: The author strongly supports them
The author is neutral and doesn't express an opinion
The author thinks they have made a positive impact on the area
The author believes they have had a negative effect, but acknowledges their intentions were good
questions.answer: The author believes they have had a negative effect, but acknowledges their intentions were good
